subject: XRP spot repricing, cross-provider perpetual open interest, liquidations, macro risk and institutional-flow distinctions

capture.note: Source pages were inspected during this run. Per-source request times and original HTTP response headers were not exposed. Provider update times are preserved separately from retrieval times and event times. No single synchronized point-in-time cutoff is asserted.

limitations: Top-of-book is not full depth or executable size.
Filename timestamp is not treated as an exact provider event time.
Rendered-text hash is not a byte-complete HTTP receipt.

observations.venue_scope: Seven perpetual-futures exchanges for open interest; five exchanges for liquidations and account long/short ratio.

limitations: The page display time has no exposed timezone.
The November 6 row is a partial daily observation.
The rendered table does not explicitly identify the volume unit.
Rendered page does not expose an exact provider update timestamp.
Displayed 6.9% change sign is not exposed in extracted text.
Headline open-interest coverage spans more markets than the seven-venue TradRadar view.

spot_market.interpretation: The independent price pages cluster around approximately $1.21-$1.22, but their capture times and market definitions differ. The earlier Kraken snapshot is not synchronized with the later TradRadar and Investing.com page displays. No short-interval return or cross-venue arbitrage inference is made.

limitations: Liquidations are reported as a lower bound because exchanges expose only part of real-time liquidations.
Long/short is account-count based, not notional exposure.
Open interest is USD-notional and can move with mark price.
The page lists 130 derivatives rows; its headline aggregate is not a seven-exchange total.
Only the first ten exchange rows were visible in the captured page output.
No exact provider update timestamp or complete raw API payload was captured.

same_venue_reconciliation.interpretation: The seven-venue sums are within approximately 8.62%, despite different update times and aggregation methods. The $4.494B CoinGecko headline covers a much broader 130-row universe and must not be compared directly with TradRadar's seven-venue $1.93B total or averaged with it.

independent_liquidation_observation.source_of_underlying_market_cap_and_sent: CoinMarketCap as quoted by The Crypto Times
independent_liquidation_observation.limitation: Different capture time and provider coverage from TradRadar; not an independent same-window measurement.

broad_market_risk_observation.limitation: Secondary reporting of a provider snapshot; not a synchronized XRP causal study.

upcoming_us_employment_situation.handling: The initial release and later revisions must be stored as separate vintages. No result is assumed before publication.

c2fo_ripple_instant_pay.status: Announced initiative with a waitlist; production transaction volume not disclosed.

bny_ripple_custody.future_rlusd_mint_redeem: Subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals.
bny_ripple_custody.tokenized_trade_finance_with_c2fo: Exploratory initiative, not completed transaction volume.

evernorth.limitation: The holdings figure is dated October 9 and is not a current wallet-level custody reconciliation.

institutional_nonprice_evidence.interpretation: Institutional custody, stablecoin settlement announcements, public equity exposure, in-kind XRP contributions and cash-funded XRP purchases are distinct. None of the cited C2FO, BNY or Coinbase RLUSD distribution announcements establishes new XRP bridge volume or incremental XRP market purchases.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The November 5 decline included a leveraged-long unwind.
supporting_evidence: TradRadar reports at least $14.97M liquidations, $14.54M long liquidations and $437,300 short liquidations.
Long accounts are 80.5% of its five-venue account sample.
disconfirming_evidence: Account ratios are not notional exposure.
Liquidation feeds are incomplete lower bounds.
USD-notional OI changes with price and venue coverage.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Broader crypto risk repricing contributed to the XRP move.
supporting_evidence: The Crypto Times reports a 5.15% broad crypto market-cap decline and Fear & Greed at 33 using a CoinMarketCap snapshot at 18:40 UTC November 5.
disconfirming_evidence: The report is secondary and not synchronized with all XRP observations.
No event study or cross-asset regression establishes causality.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Much of the headline open-interest disagreement is coverage scope rather than contradictory measurement.
supporting_evidence: CoinGecko's same seven displayed venues sum to $1.773594227B, an 8.62% difference.
CoinGecko reports 130 derivatives rows and a broader $4.494B headline aggregate.
disconfirming_evidence: Exact synchronized capture times are unavailable.
Contract normalization and duplicate-market treatment are not fully disclosed.
Only ten CoinGecko exchange rows were visible in the captured page.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Spot prices stabilized near $1.21 after the November 5 selloff.
supporting_evidence: Investing.com displays $1.2150 at 19:25:49 with timezone unspecified.
TradRadar displays a $1.2152 mark at 00:20 UTC November 6.
The earlier Kraken capture shows a $1.20659 last trade and a $1.19797 24-hour low.
disconfirming_evidence: The earlier Kraken capture is a single venue and has no provider timestamp.
A small cross-source price difference is not evidence of a durable reversal.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Institutional XRP ecosystem announcements may be misread as direct XRP market demand.
supporting_evidence: C2FO names RLUSD as Instant Pay settlement asset on XRPL.
BNY confirms XRP/RLUSD custody support but discloses no XRP-specific AUC or collateral balance.
Evernorth's approximately 473M XRP holdings are dated October 9.
disconfirming_evidence: The public announcements do not disclose every routing, liquidity or fee mechanism.
No transaction-level XRP bridge usage or current custody balance was established.

source_records.capture_note: Rendered JSON text is preserved in the referenced repository artifact; raw HTTP wire bytes and headers were not captured.

source_independence_note: Kraken is a single-venue primary exchange feed. CoinGecko and TradRadar are separate aggregators with different venue universes and update delays. Investing.com is a separate market-data aggregator. The Crypto Times article quotes a CoinMarketCap snapshot and is not independent of that underlying market-data source. C2FO/Ripple and BNY/Ripple announcements are issuer/counterparty evidence, not independent corroboration of XRP settlement volume.
model_ineligibility_reasons: No synchronized multi-venue raw HTTP captures with exact provider timestamps and response headers.
No byte-complete immutable raw-source receipts for the current aggregator observations.
Order-book depth and executable liquidity are not established by the cited top-of-book observations.
Derivatives aggregates have differing venue universes, contract definitions and update times.
Liquidation feeds are incomplete lower bounds.
Institutional announcement and capital records are contextual event features, not direct market-flow measurements.
No leakage-safe out-of-sample predictive lift or calibrated probability evidence supports a directional forecast.
